title: Application: Generative AI for Time Series Data
summary: A Dockerised Streamlit application for generating and analysing synthetic network usage time series data, aimed at enabling analysis and testing without exposing sensitive production data. It directly runs SDV's TVAESynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, and PARSynthesizer, along with sdv's evaluate_quality/run_diagnostic and sdmetrics' QualityReport, to produce and validate the synthetic datasets.
